title: Copper Leaves, Quiet Footsteps
description: A collapsing leaf-bridge maze: brittle causeways, dead-end mote bait below the true line and a deep trunk climb. Remember the path; the leaves will not wait. Expert redesign: autumn briars and falling seed weights.

identity.scope: Monthly sample route; not a final five-minute day

rooms.name: The first copper leaves
rooms.lesson: Leaf blocks fall away · the low line is a trap. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The brittle canopy
rooms.lesson: The shortcut collapses behind you · remember the true line. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: Among the roots
rooms.lesson: The stable root passage lets you reset your rhythm. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: Leaves over the ravine
rooms.lesson: Charge on the trunks · the bait leaves below are dead ends. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The copper trunk
rooms.lesson: Climb around the stable trunk ledges. Pass while the thorn head is folded.

rooms.name: The last leaf bridge
rooms.lesson: Finish the bridge before the leaves give way. Pass while the thorn head is folded.
